messages:
ellie: Mini poll: which lunchtime vibe this week? 'Quick grab' (sandwiches) or 'sit-down' (ordered bento)? Also water question: keep office filter on counter or move dispenser to pantry? Reply like: 'grab + counter' or 'bento + pantry'.
ryan: grab + pantry (less wandering)
zara: bento + counter  love a sit-down
todd: grab + counter (fastest)ellie: (jk) todd is always grab) :stuck_out_tongue: ; also please no mystery fish bento again
ellie: noted re: fish ban :grimacing:
ops-bot: poll recorded: 4 votes
zara: small follow: can we get more veggie options in the grab cases? last time they had two tuna and one chicken :confused:
ryan: agree veggies please
todd: +1 veggie
ellie: tally so far: grab 2, bento 1; counter 2, pantry 2. veggie request noted
zara: if it's a tie can we do a split order? half grab cases + one bento for the table?
ellie: that sounds perfect. ordering plan: 6 grab cases (2 veggie, 2 chicken, 2 tuna) + 1 bento to share. we'll move the dispenser to the pantry for a trial week (less traffic in kitchen). thanks everyone! :sparkles:
todd: bless you, ellie
ryan: champion of lunch logistics
ops-bot: reminder: check pantry-dispenser usage in 7 days
